pattern: Generated cards add fine surface detail that real cards leave out: dashed stitching along seams, cloth weave, speckle and pitting on stone or metal, wood-grain lines on every plank, crisp twisted-rope fibres, water droplets, and dense clusters of separate leaves. Real cards keep surfaces smooth and soft, with broad gentle shading and only a few large, simple details.
